name: session-meter
description: Band above the prompt: model, context fill, prompt-cache warmth and countdown, and a one-click handoff at 45% context.

yellowPercent.title: Context % where the meter turns yellow
yellowPercent.description: Below this the context figure has no color.

warnPercent.title: Context % to warn and offer a handoff
warnPercent.description: Turns the meter amber and bold, shows Prepare handoff, and raises one toast per session.

redPercent.title: Context % where the meter turns red
redPercent.description: At or above this the context figure is red.

coldTipPercent.title: Context % for the cold-cache tip
coldTipPercent.description: When the cache is cold and context is at least this full, the band says the next message rewrites it.
